_comment: Customer agent regression eval set. Runner: manage.py eval_agent. Add a new case whenever a production conversation reveals an agent misbehaviour. Case id should read like a bug title.

cases.name: Known customer — agent must not assume complaint
cases.notes: Real transcript from 2026-04-23. Customer wrote in from a second SIM, identified themselves by account phone, then got dragged into hotspot-vs-fibre diagnostics without ever being asked what they needed. They pushed back: 'I have not told you why I am calling, you already assumed complaint.' Later they refused to inspect hallway APs, and the system emitted two near-duplicate escalation messages.

turns.inbound: I am existing customer phone number 08066137842

expect: reply_contains_any: ['how can I help', 'what can we help', 'what can I do for you']
reply_does_not_contain_any: ['hotspot, or our home fibre', 'let me check your connection']

turns.inbound: I have not told you why I am calling, you already assumed complaint
Yes, its not working, I cannot see the wifi
No the APs are in the hallway of the lodge
I am in my room, I would not go out to check for you. I expect you to check if main router attached to my location is online
expect: reply_does_not_contain_any: ['what colour', 'lights on them', 'how many lights']
